planets.name: TOI-2018 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-2018 with a 7.44-day year, found in 2023.

text.card: TOI-2018 b was found in 2023 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-2018. Its orbit and size follow Dai et al. 2023's fit, the archive's default.
